name: Weekend with Santa at Spruce Mountain Ranch
when_note: Friday, December 4, 5 to 8 PM, and Saturday and Sunday, December 5 and 6, 10:30 AM to 1 PM
cost: Tables only: $300 for 6, $400 for 8, $500 for 10. Children 1 and under free
paras: Sarah Viera Events hosts a three day Weekend with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Spruce Mountain Ranch (Upper Ranch), 14771 Spruce Mountain Road in Larkspur, with all proceeds supporting Mount Saint Vincent. Friday, December 4, from 5 to 8 PM is Pajamas with Santa and a Polar Express movie experience, with a live hot chocolate pour at 5:15 PM. Saturday and Sunday, December 5 and 6, from 10:30 AM to 1 PM are Brunch with Santa, with story time and hay rides around the property.

Tickets are sold by table only: $300 for a table of 6, $400 for a table of 8 and $500 for a table of 10. Each price covers food, beverages, entertainment, crafts, professional photos and the Santa experience, and children 1 year and under are free. Guests are invited to bring a new, unwrapped toy for the Mount Saint Vincent gift drive. The host lists no refunds.
tip: Pick one of the three dates and book a full table early, since seating is by table only and photos with Santa start about an hour after doors open.
